verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no in-product AI feature that generates insights or suggestions from a merchant's data. The Mollie MCP server lets external AI tools such as Claude Desktop and Cursor work with the account through natural language. That is an adjacent developer building block running outside the product, not AI insights delivered inside Mollie, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
